aisha: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a 'scoreboard' reconciler to fuse latency + cost + region preference into a single per-route score. Main idea: normalize each metric to 0..1, apply per-tenant weights, add a soft region bonus, and cap extremes. Avoid tiny latency wins that blow up cost. Thoughts?
kevin: Love the concept. Two quick questions: 1) normalization window — rolling 5m or 1h? 2) how do we handle stale region probe data? :thinking_face:
maria: Concern: signal correlation. Cost and latency often move together when GPUs saturate. We should include a de-correlation penalty and outlier dampening. Also watch telemetry cardinality.
aisha: Answering both: default normalization = EMA with tau=5m (configurable per-tenant). Staleness handled via TTL multiplier: weight *= exp(-age / tau_age). Outliers: damp if z-score > 3. We'll make these knobs in the adapter.
policy-bot: Simulation snapshot: scoreboard reduced 99th tail latency by ~12% vs current rule-set with <=8% cost increase in worst-case synthetic load. Full sim artifacts uploaded to //redwood/sims/scoreboard/2026-02-15.
kevin: Can you paste the pseudocode so infra can sanity-check the perf/pipeline changes?
aisha: Sure — rough pseudocode:
```
// inputs: per-route signals {latency_ms, cost_per_token, region, signal_age}
// per-tenant config: w_lat, w_cost, pref_region, beta_region, tau_age
norm = (x, mu, sigma) -> clamp((x - mu) / sigma, 0, 1)
age_factor = exp(-signal_age / tau_age)
decorr_penalty = compute_decorrelation(latency, cost) // small positive if correlated
region_bonus = (region == pref_region) ? -beta_region : 0
score = w_lat * norm(latency) * age_factor + w_cost * norm(cost) * age_factor + region_bonus + decorr_penalty
final_score = clamp(score, 0, 1)
choose route with min(final_score) subject to capacity_gate(route)
```
kevin: Nice. A few infra notes: 1) norm needs streaming mu/sigma (numerical stability), 2) decorrelation calc should be cheap — maybe an incremental covariance estimator.
sre-tim: Safety note: we must gate final selection by a capacity check. Scoreboard should not override capacity signals (i.e., if capacity_available < threshold then disqualify). Also add a fast failback to legacy routing if the adapter crashes.
maria: Explainability is important — add per-component breakdown (latency norm, cost norm, region bonus, decorrelation penalty) to trace spans and Console so customers see why a route was chosen.
aisha: Agreed on all points. Proposed rollout plan: implement as a policy-adapter behind a feature flag, enable for internal tenants, canary to 5% of traffic for selected tenants, gather latency/cost deltas + quality evals, then expand. Will include kill-switch and automatic fallback to legacy rules if cost delta > X% or 99th latency regresses.
kevin: SGTM. I'll add a rollout checklist (telemetry tags, trace fields, canary config, ramp schedule, emergency rollback steps).
maria: +1. Also add unit tests for normalization edge cases (sigma=0, sudden spike, very stale signals).
policy-bot: Addendum: eval harness linked. Baseline run timestamp: 2026-02-15T14:22:00Z. Small note: we observed degenerate behaviour when beta_region was too large — that will be in the sim notes.
aisha: Thanks all — I'll open the RFC patch with the adapter sketch, config schema, and the rollout checklist. Marking action items: a) aisha: RFC patch + adapter prototype, b) kevin: rollout checklist and infra perf notes, c) maria: test plan + explainability fields, d) sre-tim: failure mode runbook.
kevin: I'll sync with infra tomorrow.
maria: Will prepare tests.
sre-tim: I'll draft the runbook.
policy-bot: Thread closed by aisha after action items created.
